query: What explicit power, thermal, and contact reliability metrics and acceptance thresholds (operating mW, heater time-to-temperature, contact resistance stability, adhesion/yield %) are practical for wafer-scale production?

response.query: What explicit power, thermal, and contact reliability metrics and acceptance thresholds (operating mW, heater time-to-temperature, contact resistance stability, adhesion/yield %) are practical for wafer-scale production?
response.answer: For wafer-scale production, practical metrics are: operating mW ≤ 100 mW, heater time-to-temperature ≤ 10 seconds, contact resistance stability ≤ 0.1 Ω, and adhesion/yield ≥ 95%.
